answer_1.quote: RAFT leverages an auxiliary LLM embedding to optimally select words in machine-generated text for substitution by performing a proxy task. It then employs a black-box LLM to generate replacement candidates, greedily selecting the one that most effectively subverts the target detector.

answer_2.quote: We use the Area Under the Receiver Operating Characteristic Curve (AUROC) to summarize detection accuracy for our attack framework under various thresholds. We also measure the True Positive Rate at a 5% False Positive Rate (TPR at 5% FPR)... To measure text quality, we measure the perplexity of the attacked text against GPT-NEO-2.7B... cosine similarity calculations between the original and perturbed texts...

answer_4.quote: To validate that RAFT preserves text quality, we conducted a crowd-sourced human evaluation using Amazon Mechanical Turk (MTurk).
answer_4.guideline: evaluate whether RAFT preserves text quality
